summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised from 9.00 yen to 19.00 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, a 111% increase, following upward revision of full-year earnings forecast driven by strong demand for LED lighting substrates and AI server products.
title_en: Notice Regarding Upward Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Upward Revision of Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
KYOSHA CO., LTD. has raised its dividend per share for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 from 9.00 yen to 19.00 yen, representing an increase of 10.00 yen or approximately 111%. This dividend hike follows an upward revision of the company's full-year consolidated earnings forecast, in which parent company net income attributable to shareholders was raised by 109.3% to 900 million yen, reflecting stronger-than-expected operational performance.

The company's improvement in earnings has been driven by robust demand across its core business segments. In the printed circuit board business, orders for LED lighting and home appliance products, automotive applications, and metal substrates for electronic components have remained strong both domestically and internationally. Operations in Indonesia have also maintained solid order momentum, particularly in the office equipment sector. The mounting-related business continues to benefit from continued strong orders for AI server applications and aerospace-related products.

The company maintains a basic dividend policy of prioritizing reinvestment in strengthening its management foundation, growth businesses, and structural reforms, with the objective of achieving a dividend payout ratio of 30%. The dividend increase reflects confidence in sustained earnings improvement, though the company acknowledges that downside risks such as Middle East geopolitical tensions and potential raw material price volatility related to AI-driven demand growth could affect results in the second half of the fiscal year.
